# DSH plugin config. Generated by packages/deepseek-harness-extension/scripts/interface-listing.mjs; do not edit.
# Run `pnpm interfaces` after changing them. Format: ITEM | ATTRIBUTES | DESCRIPTION
calls | object | Calling configuration; absent or voice.enabled!==true keeps calls fail-closed offline
calls.voice.agentId | string, required | Harness Agent id that carries call consultations
calls.voice.allowConsultSessionPersistence | boolean, default false | Required true for any non-none tool policy
calls.voice.conferences.groups | object | Per-group rules keyed by @chatroom id or *: autoJoin/autoJoinAllowFrom/toolPolicy/ownerInviterToolPolicy/sessionKey
calls.voice.consultation | object | { timeoutMs 1000..120000 (30000), summary boolean (true), recentMessages 0..50 (10) }
calls.voice.inboundAllowFrom | string[], default [] | Exact caller wxids that may call in
calls.voice.inboundPolicy | values disabled|allowlist, default disabled | Inbound call admission; allowlist answers only listed callers
calls.voice.maxDurationSeconds | number 30..3600, default 3600 | Hard call duration cap
calls.voice.mode | values bidi|agent, default bidi | agent runs consultation turns per utterance; bidi needs realtime
calls.voice.outboundAllowTo | string[], default [] | Exact callees the coordinator may dial
calls.voice.outboundPolicy | values disabled|allowlist, default disabled | Coordinator-dialed calls require allowlist
calls.voice.outboundToolAllowFrom | string[], default [] | Owner DMs allowed to invoke wechat_call mutations
calls.voice.realtime | object | OpenAI realtime: provider/model/voice/instructions/apiKeyCredentialRef/agentContext/recentContext/consultPolicy/fastContext
calls.voice.sessionScope | values per-contact|per-call, default per-contact | Call session key scope
calls.voice.toolPolicy | values none|safe-read-only|owner, default none | Tool scope for call consultation sessions (owner needs an exact owner match)
calls.voice.transcription | object | STT provider/model/language (openai)
dmAllowFrom | string[], default [] | Allowed DM sender ids (supports *)
dmPolicy | values disabled|allowlist|open, default disabled | Direct-message admission policy
gatewayFacade | boolean, default false | Expose the local gateway facade (M6; default off)
groupAllowFrom | string[], default [] | Allowed group chat ids (supports *)
groupPolicy | values disabled|allowlist, default disabled | Group-chat admission policy
groupSenderAllowFrom | string[], default [] | Allowed group sender ids (supports *)
historyLimit | number, default 50 | Maximum catch-up messages per reconnect window
native.accountId | string, default default | Native account id this plugin instance serves
native.consumerStateDir | string | Directory for consumer cursor state
native.dataDir | string | Daemon data directory for managed mode
native.endpoint | string, default http://127.0.0.1:6790 | Native daemon HTTP endpoint (loopback http or https)
native.executable | string | Daemon executable path for managed mode
native.mode | values external|managed, default external | Connect to an external daemon or spawn a managed one
native.readinessTimeoutMs | number, default 15000 | Managed daemon readiness timeout
native.serverConfig | string | Daemon server config path for managed mode
native.stopTimeoutMs | number, default 8000 | Managed daemon stop timeout
native.tokenCredentialRef | string, default WECHAT_DAEMON_TOKEN | Credential reference holding the native daemon token
push.enabled | boolean, default false | Arm the wechat_push tool for every DSH session (fail-closed default)
push.targets | string[], default [] | Exact wxids / @chatroom ids wechat_push may deliver to; at least one is required
readPolicy | values on_inbound|never|on_model_dispatch, default on_inbound | Reserved read-receipt policy; the native daemon exposes no read API today, so this has no effect yet
requireMentionInGroups | boolean, default true | Require a real mention before answering in groups
tools.ownerAllowFrom | string[], default [] | Exact DM wxids treated as the account owner (enables owner tools; archive stays deny-by-default)
